scope: static explicit operator-board export path template

checks.name: JSON template, CLI help, focused tests, and diff check
checks.command: python3 -m json.tool house/relay/examples/operator-board-export-paths.example.json >/dev/null && python3 -m house.relay.cli export-operator-board --help >/dev/null && python3 -m unittest house.relay.tests.test_cli house.relay.tests.test_operator_board_export && git diff --check

checks.name: all component House test suites
checks.command: for test_dir in $(find house -type d -name tests -print | sort); do python3 -m unittest discover -s "$test_dir" -p 'test_*.py'; done

claim_ceiling: Static documentation only. It does not execute board export, load the template automatically, select a source/destination, scan storage, write data, activate a dashboard, open a relay, or grant authority.
